Adeia Appoints Dipti Vachani as Chief Executive Officer

# Adeia Appoints Dipti Vachani as Chief Executive Officer

 By: Adeia Inc. via GlobeNewswire 

September 28, 2026 at 16:05 PM EDT

SAN JOSE, Calif., Sept. 28, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Adeia Inc. (Nasdaq: ADEA), the technology company pioneering foundational innovations that shape how the world computes, connects, and experiences entertainment, today announced that its board of directors (the “Board”) has appointed Dipti Vachani as chief executive officer, effective October 12, 2026. Vachani will also join the Board, effective the same day. She succeeds Paul E. Davis, who in May 2026 informed the company of his intention to step down as chief executive officer and member of the Board to focus on his health and personal pursuits. Davis has agreed to serve in an advisory capacity through the end of the year to support a smooth transition.

Vachani brings to Adeia a tremendous wealth of broad leadership experience, technical credibility and meaningful partnerships, developed over nearly 30 years in the semiconductor industry. She has deep expertise in semiconductor ecosystems, advanced computer architectures, AI infrastructure, and long-cycle commercial relationships with demonstrated success expanding global businesses into new sectors.

Vachani most recently served as senior vice president, general manager, Automotive Business Unit for Arm Limited, a position she held from 2018 until 2026, where she successfully developed market specific IP programs into new, high-value recurring revenue streams. She also helped develop Arm Total Access and Arm Flexible Access, expanding IP utilization across the licensee base, and founded the SOAFEE Alliance, which today includes more than 200 member companies. From 2015 to 2018, Vachani was vice president, general manager of Intel Corporation’s Internet of Things Group. Prior to Intel, Vachani was vice president, general manager, Power, Lighting and Display at Skyworks Solutions beginning in 2013. Before Skyworks, Vachani held various program and product line positions at Texas Instruments, Inc. ending as vice president, general manager, Single Core Processors.

Vachani served as a member of the board of directors of Axcelis Technologies, Inc., a publicly traded semiconductor equipment manufacturer, from 2022 to 2025. Vachani earned a Bachelor of Science degree in Computer Engineering from Texas A&M University and an Executive M.B.A. from The University of Texas at Austin.

The Board selected Vachani for her proven track record and commitment to innovation to build upon Adeia’s successful transformation. She will continue the focus on strengthening our technology leadership in the semiconductor and media markets, diversifying our recurring revenue streams beyond Pay-TV, identifying and investing in new growth areas, and fostering a culture that empowers our people to achieve the company’s long-term value creation goals.

“Dipti Vachani is the right leader for Adeia’s next chapter,” said Dan Moloney, chairman of the Board. “The Board’s Transition Committee conducted a rigorous search process and considered an exceptional field of candidates, and Vachani stood out for her ability to translate R&D capabilities and innovation roadmap into greater strategic relevance, new markets, stronger customer and ecosystem pull, and ultimately greater shareholder value. Our business today is positioned for continued revenue growth, led by an exceptional executive team with decades of experience and past successes. On behalf of the entire Board, I also want to thank Paul for four years of exceptional leadership and guidance; he leaves the company in a position of significant financial and strategic strength.”

“It is an honor to be chosen to lead Adeia,” said Dipti Vachani. “Adeia’s award-winning portfolio of more than 14,250 worldwide patent assets, its deep culture of invention, and the momentum the team has built provide a remarkable foundation for th

Adeia Inc. Appoints Dipti Vachani as CEO, Announces Leadership Transition and Compensation Details

# Adeia Inc. Appoints Dipti Vachani as CEO, Announces Leadership Transition and Compensation Details 

 3 min read | September 28, 2026 08:24 PM PDT | By Aditi Sarkar 

 Google News: 

On September 28, 2026, Adeia Inc. submitted a Form 8-K revealing that Paul E. Davis resigned as CEO and board member, with Dipti Vachani named as his successor, both effective October 12, 2026.

### Key Highlights

- CEO Resignation: Paul E. Davis stepped down as chief executive officer and board member effective October 12, 2026, to prioritize his health and personal interests.
- New CEO Appointment: Dipti Vachani, aged 53, was appointed CEO and to fill the vacant board seat, effective October 12, 2026.
- Base Salary: Vachani’s annual base salary is set at $730,000 with a target annual bonus opportunity equal to 100% of her base salary.
- Equity Compensation: Vachani’s total equity award target grant date value amounts to $11,000,000, comprising $4,400,000 in time-based RSUs and $6,600,000 in performance-based RSUs.
- Davis Consulting Agreement: Davis will act as a consultant until December 31, 2026, for a fixed fee of $183,000, with Adeia covering COBRA premiums through September 30, 2027.
- Severance Provisions: The CEO Severance Agreement includes an initial three-year term with automatic one-year renewals, offering 150% of salary plus target bonus as a lump sum outside a change-in-control window, or 200% within such a window.

## Details on Leadership Change and Compensation at Adeia Inc.

The filing states that Davis informed the Company and Board of his intent to resign on May 4, 2026. His formal resignation was submitted and accepted on September 24, 2026. Following a recommendation from the transition committee, the Board appointed Dipti Vachani as CEO and to the Board, effective October 12, 2026, designated the "CEO Commencement Date."

Vachani brings nearly 30 years of semiconductor industry experience. From 2018 to May 2026, she was senior vice president and general manager of the Automotive Business Unit at Arm Limited (NASDAQ:ARM) ARM (NASDAQ:ARM) . Previously, she held vice president and general manager roles at Intel Corporation (NASDAQ:INTC) INTC (NASDAQ:INTC) and Skyworks Solutions (NASDAQ:SWKS) SWKS (NASDAQ:SWKS) , and earlier roles at Texas Instruments, Inc. (NASDAQ:TXN) TXN (NASDAQ:TXN) . She also served on the Board of Directors of Axcelis Technologies (NASDAQ:ACLS) ACLS (NASDAQ:ACLS) from 2022 to 2025. Vachani earned a B.S. in Computer Engineering from Texas A&M University and an Executive M.B.A. from the University of Texas at Austin, per the filing.

Regarding Davis’s departure, the Company and Davis entered a consulting agreement dated September 25, 2026, effective October 12, 2026. Davis will receive a fixed consulting fee of $183,000 through December 31, 2026, with the consulting period excluded from continuous service for equity vesting. Under Vachani’s CEO Severance Agreement, termination without cause or resignation for good reason outside a change-in-control period entitles her to a lump sum of 150% of base salary plus target bonus, health benefits continuation for up to 18 months, and partial equity acceleration. Within three months before or twelve months after a change in control, the lump sum rises to 200% and health benefits extend to 24 months. Adeia Inc. is traded on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under NASDAQ:ADEA.

## Summary of Disclosure

Adeia Inc. announced the CEO transition from Paul E. Davis to Dipti Vachani effective October 12, 2026, detailing Davis’s consulting arrangement and the comprehensive compensation and severance terms for Vachani associated with her appointment.
